title: Define how receiver captures redact host paths
body:
Outcome: one sanctioned convention for receiver captures that contain host paths (for example a documented placeholder accepted by both KRN-12 review and the host-path guard), so judges do not flag the redaction as non-verbatim.
Evidence: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/predecessor-retire/ (PR #159). Review record 3 of PR #159: one judge BLOCKING "Herdr replies no longer captured verbatim" after the host-path guard forced /work/repo; resolved by lead override.
